title: TRICARE Reserve Select Reserve Select Closing Reconciliation - Premium Accounting Bulletin
content:
**Premium accounting bulletin - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Reserve Select.**

## The calculation

The Reserve Select closing reconciliation is the termination credit taken bill by bill: for each bill taken in, the days of its period after the termination date, multiplied by the bill's daily amount, with nothing taken off for credits already standing; each bill's figure is rounded to the cent and the figures are added.

## Terms

- **Termination date.** The termination date the Reserve Select closing reconciliation works from is the later of the date asked for in the pending request and the date that request was taken.
- **Closing period.** The closing period is the most recently paid coverage month (the coverage month of the bill that the latest posted premium payment on the plan settles) and, where a later coverage month has been billed, that latest-billed month (the coverage month of the plan's monthly bill with the latest due date); the Reserve Select closing reconciliation takes in the monthly bill and the coverage-type adjustment bill of each month of the closing period, each for the days of its own period, which end on the last day of its month.
- **Daily amount.** Each monthly bill taken in has as its daily amount the amount billed divided by the days the bill covers, credited back where a payment stands against it and withdrawn where none does; each coverage-type adjustment bill taken in has as its daily amount the part of it still unpaid divided by the days it covers, the part paid on it coming back through the monthly bill of its month.
- **Days of a bill's period after the termination date.** The days of the bill's own period that follow the termination date, through the last day of its month; where the termination date falls before the period began, every day of the period.
- **Total.** The Reserve Select closing reconciliation is the sum, over the bills taken in, of what each bill brings in; what each bill brings in is rounded to the cent and never less than zero, and the sum is rounded to the cent and never less than zero.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A TRICARE Reserve Select plan moved from Member-Only to Member-and-Family on 20 June. The latest payment settled the June monthly bill of 61.17 (30 days); a June coverage-type adjustment bill of 88.24 covers 20 to 30 June and has 40.00 paid on it; the July monthly bill of 301.82 (31 days) is billed and unpaid. The pending request asks for 14 June and was taken on 10 June, so the termination date is 14 June.

| Bill taken in | Days of its period after 14 June | Daily amount | Figure |
|---|---|---|---|
| June monthly bill | 15 to 30 June, 16 | 61.17 divided by 30 | 32.624, rounded to 32.62 |
| June adjustment bill | 20 to 30 June, 11 | the unpaid 48.24 divided by 11 | 48.24 |
| July monthly bill | 1 to 31 July, 31 | 301.82 divided by 31 | 301.82 |
| Closing reconciliation | | | 32.62 and 48.24 and 301.82 added, 382.68 |
